answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A delta of per-task receipts records who did what, and the juniper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
